title: Business Entity Concept
statement: The business and its owner are two separate entities, so only the transactions of the business are recorded in its books.
illustration: Ramesh starts a shop with ₹1,00,000. The business owes him this amount as capital. If he later takes ₹5,000 from the till to pay his home electricity bill, it is recorded as *drawings*, not as a business expense.
significance: Without it, personal spending would mix with business costs and the profit shown would be wrong.
